back: An amount due within twelve months or in the normal operating cycle: trade payables, accruals, tax payable, declared dividends, a bank overdraft.
Total assets = total equity (share capital + reserves) + total liabilities.

front: How is a bank overdraft shown?
back: As a current liability. It is not netted against cash in hand.

front: When is a dividend a liability?
back: Only if it is declared before the year end. A dividend recommended later is a note.
Current assets ÷ current liabilities, shown as x : 1.
Cost (or valuation) of a non-current asset less accumulated depreciation (ZIMSEC: net book value).
Non-current liability if repayable after more than twelve months; the part due within twelve months is current.
Receivables after the write-off, less the allowance for irrecoverable debts.
